raw_statement: CSR: Claim intake for Derek Patterson. Insured reports an incident on Saturday night, September 19, 2026, at approximately 11:42 PM. Vehicle involved is 2022 BMW 330i xDrive, white, license plate IL-DPX-8841, VIN 3MW5R1J05N8B74291, odometer 41,200. Insured states: 'I was driving northbound on I-90/94 heading home around mile marker 52 near Chicago. Heavy downpour, sheets of rain, couldn't see twenty feet ahead. Suddenly there's this huge shredded truck tire or broken cargo sitting right in my lane. I jerked the steering wheel hard right to miss it and ended up slamming the passenger front corner directly into the concrete highway divider barrier. The bumper cover ripped clean off on the right, the hood buckled up like an accordion, the right front fender got crushed back into the wheel well, and the right adaptive LED headlight is completely pulverized. The radiator and A/C condenser got punctured and dumped green coolant all over the asphalt. The right alloy wheel has massive curb rash and gouges, and the passenger side mirror got sheared off when scraping the wall. The car died immediately and wouldn't turn over. It wasn't drivable so I had to call a private flatbed tow to Prestige Auto Body.' When asked about police: 'It was midnight, pouring rain, and no other cars were hit, so I didn't bother waiting an hour on the shoulder for state troopers.' Injuries: Insured reports sprained/sore right wrist from white-knuckling the steering wheel during the swerve, taking Advil, hasn't seen a doctor yet.
